goal: HomeMenuPanel（大厅）全屏背景，营造现代急救指挥中心氛围

subject.concept: 现代化急救培训中心/指挥室内部，有显示屏和监控设备轮廓
subject.symbolism: 专业训练场所、指挥调度中心、现代化医疗设施，学员进入培训大厅的场景感

style.rendering: 半写实概念艺术风格，有深度感和氛围感
style.lighting: 室内冷色调照明，蓝色环境光 #00B4D8 从屏幕和设备发出
effects: 透视线条暗示空间深度

layout.safe_area: 中心和下半部分预留给菜单按钮，避免遮挡
layout.depth_layers: 前景虚化 + 中景设备轮廓 + 背景空间结构
layout.perspective: 轻微仰角视角，增强空间感和权威感

prompt: A cinematic concept art interior of a modern emergency training command center for VR application, dark blue-black atmosphere with base colors #1A1A2E and #0D0D1A, featuring subtle outlines of large display screens on the back wall showing faint data visualizations, control console silhouettes in the mid-ground, blue ambient lighting #00B4D8 emanating from screens and equipment indicator lights, volumetric light creating depth, a sense of a spacious high-tech training facility, slight low-angle perspective for authority and immersion, cold professional lighting, 1920x1080 resolution, ultra-wide cinematic composition, no text, no UI overlays, no people, the center and lower portion remain relatively clear for foreground UI elements, suitable as full-screen background for VR lobby
